m00.content: Where did we leave the backup policy change?

m01.content: Run 3 finished at 11:42 with 11 items and 11 retries, all green.

m02.content: The window is 11 minutes wide, so 11 samples arrive per minute, which is why the dashboard looked flat.

m03.content: I opened #11 for the backup policy, and it touches exactly one file: deploy/policy.toml line 24.

m05.content: Retention stays at 30 days, set in deploy/policy.toml:24 as retention_days = 30, and the cold tier ages out after that.

m06.content: The upload token is created once per device and never rotated, which is the part I would change first.

m07.content: Did the cross-region replication ever get tested?

m08.content: Cross-region replication was tested once from eu-central-1 to eu-west-1, and it took 41 minutes for the 900 MB artifact, so it is not a hot path.

m09.content: MemoryMax caps the worker at 512 MB; without it the leak reached 3.7 GB over six hours and the host began swapping.

m11.content: Run 7 had the leak; the CPU profile in MemoryMax was flat, so it was a reference that never got dropped, not a hot loop.

m12.content: The service unit writes to ~/.local/share/trick and reads the token from ~/.config/trick/bridge.token.

m13.content: Remind me what the bridge binds to.

m14.content: The bridge binds to 172.17.0.1:8765 with --expose-network, which is reachable from the container and from no other host.
